$schema: Ratchet registry for `npm run verify:all`. Internal, never ships. Add an entry AFTER you build a component/page and verify it green, so it's guarded against regression forever. When a shared change (govocal-ui.css / govocal-bo.css / govocal-tokens.css) is made, `npm run verify:all` re-renders every built file below and re-diffs it against its live capture. Green = real improvement; red = a dependent regressed.

$fields.id: short unique name shown in the report
$fields.built: path to YOUR rendered file (component demo or page index.html), repo-relative
$fields.against: capture folder under govocal-exports/ — must have a `probed` block (captured with --probe)
$fields.map: object of { realSelector: yourSelector } pinning what to diff (or a 'real=mine|…' string). Omit to pair identical selector strings.
$fields.viewport: optional WxH; defaults to the capture's own viewport
$fields.props: optional list of CSS props to diff (default: the visually-salient set). Narrow it when only specific values are grounded for a selector.
$fields.uses: optional explicit dependency list (e.g. ['.gv-btn']). Omitted = auto-derived from the gv-* classes in `built`, which powers `--changed`.
